# NYC Slice of Life

> NYC Slice of Life is a curated guide for NYC pop-ups, date ideas, and weekend plans.
> Born from a love of exploring the city beyond the 9 to 5, it spotlights everything
> from beauty pop-ups to art installations, helping locals and visitors make the most
> of their nights and weekends in New York City.

> See also: sitemap.xml for a complete machine-readable page index.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://nycsliceoflife.com/): Discover upcoming NYC pop-ups, curated date ideas, and weekend plans for locals and visitors.
- [Upcoming NYC Pop-ups](https://nycsliceoflife.com/pop-ups.html): Browse all active and upcoming NYC pop-up events, from beauty and art to installations and more.
- [Date Ideas](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-ideas.html): Curated NYC date ideas and unique things to do, for locals and visitors alike.
- [Events Calendar](https://nycsliceoflife.com/calendar.html): Full calendar view of upcoming NYC pop-up events.
- [About Us](https://nycsliceoflife.com/about.html): Learn about NYC Slice of Life — a curated guide born from a love of exploring NYC beyond the 9 to 5.
- [Contact Us](https://nycsliceoflife.com/contact_us.html): Get in touch with the NYC Slice of Life team.

## Date Ideas

- [Archery in NYC Parks](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=free-archery-in-nyc-parks): Free ranger-led archery lessons in parks across the city — all equipment and instruction provided, no RSVP needed.
- [Brooklyn Museum x Art of Manga](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=brooklyn-museum-x-art-of-manga): See over 600 drawings from your favorite manga and stop by the gift shop for Gashapon machines.
- [Budgie Landing at the Bronx Zoo](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=budgie-landing-at-the-bronx-zoo): Feed free-flying budgies from a seed stick inside the Bronx Zoo's colorful summer aviary.
- [Free Garden Tours at the Met Cloisters](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=free-garden-tours-at-the-met-cloisters): Wander medieval gardens and learn the medicinal, artistic, and magical uses of their plants on a daily guided tour.
- [Free Met Opera Tickets](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=free-met-opera-tickets): Free Met Opera tickets for NYC residents
- [Holland Bikes Tours & Rentals](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=holland-bikes-tours-and-rentals): Guided e-bike tours, rentals, and personalized experiences in Manhattan and Brooklyn; perfect for fall!
- [Jellycat Diner](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=jellycat-diner): The Jellycat Diner is back at FAO Schwarz with a new menu, personalized diner packaging, and exclusive goodies; reservations recommended!
- [Lincoln Center Choose-What-You-Pay Shows](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=lincoln-center-choose-what-you-pay-shows): Catch jazz, R&B, musical theater, and orchestral shows at Lincoln Center's iconic venues from just $5.
- [Met Cloisters Open Studio](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=met-cloisters-open-studio): Drop into artist-led demos and hands-on art-making at the Cloisters — all materials provided, all ages welcome.
- [MoMA Free Fridays & Drawing Sessions](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=moma-free-fridays-and-drawing-sessions): MoMA stays open late every Friday with free admission for New York State residents, plus galleries and drawing sessions.
- [Seining at NYC Parks](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=seining-at-nyc-parks): Join Urban Park Rangers to seine NYC waterways and catch fish with nets. Equipment provided. Ages 8+. First come, first served.
- [Whitney Museum Free Fridays](https://nycsliceoflife.com/date-idea.html?id=whitney-museum-free-fridays): Free Friday evenings at the Whitney with art, drinks, music, and skyline views — advance tickets recommended.
